name: Tameeni Insurance
verdict: Tameeni is an insurance platform of Rasan Information Technology Company, a Saudi fintech listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul 8313, since June 2024). Nothing found.
note: Chest sponsor on several Saudi Pro League shirts (listed 'front' on the 2026-27 kits, matching the league-wide upper-chest position). Al-Shabab history: official sponsor announced by the club in 2022 (alshabab-sc.sa/blogs/484, 'تأميني راعياً رسمياً لنادي الشباب') and welcomed again as a main sponsor on 2025-08-28 (club X post, https://x.com/AlShababSaudiFC/status/1961171021513326669); the Tameeni patch is visible on the right chest of the 2026-27 home shirt in the SPL's official kit gallery. Rasan is listed on Tadawul (8313, since June 2024); MENAbytes named Saudi VC Impact46 its largest shareholder around the IPO, and no state body or fund was found in the chain.
